summary: Frontend-only testing of the new dedicated per-emirate SEO landing pages, sitemap/robots, and regressions. All 10 checks passed: 4 emirate pages load with unique H1, per-page title, meta description, canonical (ending /market-areas/<slug>); invalid region redirects to /market-areas; listing page has own SEO title and 4 clickable region links; 10 product cards + 3 other-region links per emirate page; SEO no-clobber verified after 3.5s wait; SEO cleanup on nav to Home restores site title; sitemap.xml and robots.txt return 200 and sitemap includes all 4 emirate URLs; products regression intact (10 cards); mobile 390px has zero horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: useSeoSettings.js uses module-level `defaults` and `pageActive` globals. Works, but if two page-level SEO hooks mount concurrently (e.g., during route transitions), the cleanup of one may re-apply defaults before the other applies its overrides. Currently fine because React unmounts previous route first, but worth noting for future.
MarketAreaDetailPage.jsx: page uses same IMG.largeFormat hero image for all four emirates — consider per-emirate hero images for stronger SEO/UX differentiation.
sitemap.xml and robots.txt have hardcoded preview URL (emirates-prints.preview.emergentagent.com). Should be templated for production domain or generated at build.
